canonical_name: IEEE EUI-48 / MAC address-block registration system
roles: allocate organizationally controlled blocks for EUI-48/EUI-64 identifiers
addressing: MA-L includes an OUI and approximately 2^24 EUI-48 values; MA-M and MA-S provide smaller blocks. Universally administered and locally administered addresses are distinct concepts.
open_questions: Reconstruct chronology from OUI/IAB/OUI-36 terminology to MA-L/MA-M/MA-S.
Trace local-administered and randomized MAC practices separately from IEEE-assigned universal blocks.
notes: An OUI lookup identifies the registered block assignee, not necessarily the physical manufacturer of the final device.
